race.comment: BROWN SUGAR (7) handy mare who strips fitter after resuming with a game fourth from back in the field over 1100m at Canterbury with 58kg. Comes to hand quickly and expect to see her hold a forward position today. The one to beat. CRYPTONIC (1) consistent gelding who gets every chance at this level with the claim. Sound run first up, then went under narrowly when second over 1200m at Illawarra Grange. Can give this a great shake. GRINZINGER POD (4) second run for the new yard she led throughout with the 59kg to salute over 1200m at Gosford in BM64 class. Can keep the momentum going from the low draw. BETTER LATE (6) resumed from his two good trials with a gritty on-speed second as fav over 1200m at Gosford. Drops in weight and has to contend with the sticky barrier here. Sure to be thereabouts.
